India faces England in T20 series decider at Trent Bridge

The Indian cricket team is preparing for the third T20 match against England at Trent Bridge. The team is reportedly considering changes to its bowling lineup to improve performance and stay competitive in the series. The match's outcome is crucial for India to keep the series alive.
